_comment: Every lamp-* binary the workspace builds, by what the lamp-os package does with it (main's scripts/release/lamp_os_package.py reads this). core: the parts, packaged with their units. optional: carried when built, no unit. provisioning: factory tools, in the generic package's tools/. development: never packaged. A new binary goes in one list in the same pull request; CI fails otherwise (tools/package-binaries.sh). lamp-apps (development) is the OLD name of the apps helper, now lamp-apps-manage, a core part because the boot start and the helper's units name it on every lamp even with LAMP_STORE_APPS off (its install folder would be /opt/lampOS/apps, the apps' own code folder): it is never built and never packaged, and is listed only because a CI cache restored from before the rename can still hold the stale file.
